name: 張漢利
objective: This course introduces fundamental statistical concepts and analytical tools for data-driven decision-making. This course is offered under the Taiwan AI College Alliance (TAICA) program. Lectures are delivered asynchronously via online meeting platform that can be found in NTU COOL (https://cool.ntu.edu.tw/).
schedule:
* Course Introduction & Data Fundamentals
* Data Types, Sampling Methods, and Experimental Design
* Summarizing Data Numerical & Graphical Representations
* Basic Probability Rules, Conditional Probability, and Independence
* Random Variables, Normal Distribution, and Binomial Distribution
* Sampling Distributions and Central Limit Theorem
* Confidence Intervals and Point Estimates
* Midterm Exam (Synchronized, In-Person 9:30 AM – 12:00 PM)
* Hypothesis Testing for Single Categorical Proportions
* Chi-Square Tests for Independence and Goodness-of-Fit
* Hypothesis Testing & Confidence Intervals for Single Means
* Comparing Two Independent Means and Paired Data Analysis
* Introduction to Simple Linear Regression & Correlation
* Model Fitting, Least Squares Method, and Residual Analysis
* Final Exam (Synchronized, In-Person 9:30 AM – 12:00 PM)
* Course Review & Final Grade Assessment
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



Required Textbook: Diez, D. M., Barr, C. D., & Çetinkaya-Rundel, M. (2019). OpenIntro Statistics (4th ed.).
Supplementary Reference: Rosling, H., Rosling, O., & Rönnlund, A. R. (2018). Factfulness: Ten Reasons We're Wrong About the World.
consultation: Local student support and consultation are available during scheduled office hours, via email, and through the assigned Teaching Assistant
延伸教學與資源:
● 混成學習 (Blended Learning)
課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。
Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
課程是否導入AI:
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
